verdict.rationale: Lium documents clusters: several whole machines on the same RDMA fabric for one distributed job. That covers part of connecting instances over a private interconnect. Nothing in the evidence documents exposing or mapping ports to serve applications from a pod. The built-in Jupyter notebook toggle is a related feature, not general port exposure. Missing for 10: documented port exposure or mapping for serving apps, general private networking between individual pods outside clusters, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: A cluster is several whole machines on the same RDMA fabric, for one distributed job.
